jobs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / precise-object-edit. Create a genuinely NEW center painting for the attached Estudário bronze achievement, not a retouch of the old character or arm routes. Image 1 is the old badge, only a reference for the table/exam/lamp/library story and amber light; completely replace its character, props layout, pose and camera. Image 2 is the exact bronze frame, fixed shape, scale, thickness, crest and empty ribbon. Image 3 is the collection's ink/gouache/colored-pencil STYLE and Folha identity reference only, never copy its pose.

NEW COMPOSITION: Folha is a medium-small OPEN indigo hardcover book floating centrally above a warmly lit study desk, slightly turned three-quarter right. Two broad cream INNER pages and a coherent center gutter, kind bright eyes and a proud friendly smile, indigo graduation cap and mint bookmark. Body occupies only the middle third of the window, leaving clear space on BOTH sides. A compact red cross hovers immediately above his LEFT cream palm at left of the entire book. A luminous green check hovers immediately above his RIGHT cream palm at right of the entire book. A small golden spark between the symbols tells the transformation. The left and right hands are CLOSE beside their corresponding outer cover edges. Exactly TWO short, uncomplicated indigo arms: left cover SIDE -> left hand holding X; right cover SIDE -> right hand holding check. Both proximal roots are hidden behind their cover edge, while the short exposed forearms extend OUTWARD directly. No arm crosses the book, no looping around or behind its body, no raised arm on the top edge, no detached glove, no third arm/hand and NO loose study card in any hand. Two hands total, one per short arm. No legs/feet/human body.

Below on the table remains an exam sheet with a simple red cross changing to a green check, a pen; lamp at right, warmly painted stacked books and shelves. Preserve collection's luxurious tactile dip-pen contours, layered gouache, colored-pencil grain and warm amber lighting. Beautiful storytelling detail, coherent anatomy, not a plastic 3D icon. Keep all content inside the frame's central window. The complete exterior remains alpha transparent, fixed bronze frame and empty ribbon unchanged. No words, letters, numbers, pseudo-text or watermarks. One whole square badge only. Before finishing count 2 arms and 2 hands and trace each from lateral hardcover contour to its hand.

Use case: illustration-story / compositional remake. Paint a wholly NEW Estudário sapphire achievement scene. Image 1 is the rejected old badge and serves ONLY as a reminder of the seedling-card garden, watering can and window light; do NOT preserve its book geometry, pose, arm paths or prop placement. Image 2 is the fixed SAPPHIRE frame, exact size, wreath, gemstones, crest and empty ribbon, which must remain unchanged. Image 3 is the collection's ink/gouache/colored-pencil STYLE and open-book Folha identity reference only; do not copy that reference pose.

NEW VIEW AND ACTION: an intimate gardener scene, seen at a gentle downward three-quarter angle. Folha floats centered in the upper-middle of the scene and leans forward slightly toward a row of little study-card seedlings below. He is a real OPEN indigo hardcover book, TWO broad cream INNER page planes and clear center gutter, welcoming concentrated eyes looking at the water, small tender smile, indigo graduation cap, mint bookmark. Show his face on the broad cream inner pages; only a narrow indigo cover perimeter behind them, never a huge rear-cover panel facing camera. The character is medium-sized so there is room beside BOTH outer cover sides.

A SMALL beautiful silver watering can with an indigo handle and one inset sapphire is held CLOSE directly IN FRONT of the LOWER body, tilted slightly so its short spout at right pours a sparkling mint stream onto the sprouting cards. Exactly TWO small cream mitten hands visibly hold the can: LEFT hand grips the handle at the can's left side, RIGHT hand firmly supports the can's right body beside the spout. Exactly TWO SHORT indigo arms lead DIRECTLY from the corresponding LEFT and RIGHT hardcover SIDE edges to these two hands, both in front. Put the root behind the corresponding cover edge so it is naturally hidden. Arms are short and gently bent, never long ribbons, never around or behind the book, never crossing its face or each other. Each hand must clearly connect to ONE arm connected to the book. No extra arm/hand, no glove fragment, no detached limb, no legs, feet, shoes or human torso. Bring the can closer instead of lengthening an arm.

Foreground: a jewel-like garden bed with five cream study cards, simple mint leaf pictograms, tiny sprouts, rich soil, dew and leaves. Warm arched window light enters from upper right; softly painted shelves, vines and books make the background. Keep the same tactile dip-pen ink contours, layered gouache, colored-pencil grain and rich warm luminous palette as the collection, rather than a plastic 3D icon. Scene stays within the central frame opening. Genuine alpha-transparent exterior. Sapphire frame and fully EMPTY indigo ribbon unchanged. NO letters, numbers, words, pseudo-writing or watermark anywhere. One complete square badge only. FINAL CHECK: trace left side -> short arm -> left hand -> can, and right side -> short arm -> right hand -> can; count exactly 2 arms and 2 hands.
